$comment: Snapshot of the plugins enabled on the claude.ai account of Pol4720.
Re-captured 2026-09-03 from the live account (ListPlugins): still none enabled.
Plugins bundle skills, slash commands, hooks, agents and MCP servers. They are
installed from a marketplace at claude.ai (or with /plugin in Claude Code) and
cannot be installed from a file — this inventory records the decision, not the
`recommended_not_installed` below was verified against the live catalogue with
SearchPlugins: all four exist in knowledge-work-plugins, all four are available on

later session can confirm it installed the same thing this one recommended.
captured_with: ListPlugins + SearchPlugins, from a live Claude Code session

marketplaces_visible.name: knowledge-work-plugins
marketplaces_visible.note: The default Anthropic marketplace. Every recommendation below comes from it.

recommended_not_installed.name: engineering
recommended_not_installed.why: The daily-driver pass. Composes with repo-audit-fixer rather than competing with it: the audit skill is the once-per-milestone deep pass, these are the small ones run constantly.

recommended_not_installed.name: security-guidance
recommended_not_installed.why: Closes the loop repo-audit-fixer opens: catches injection, XSS, SSRF, hardcoded secrets and 25+ other classes at write time rather than at audit time. Maps onto the SEC-* categories of the audit taxonomy.
recommended_not_installed.note: Privileged reach. Its hooks inspect code as it is written — that is what makes it useful, and it is worth knowing before enabling it.

recommended_not_installed.name: data
recommended_not_installed.why: Statistical analysis, dataset validation and SQL. data:validate-data targets the defect class that does the most damage in research code — a data-integrity problem that produces a plausible wrong number.

recommended_not_installed.name: bio-research
recommended_not_installed.why: Life-sciences R&D tooling. Adds skills rather than connections — its ChEMBL and PubMed servers are already connected on this account.
